_note: Settings for npm run civic. 'schedules' holds the dates the City publishes once a year (City Council Regular Meetings Schedule and Subcommittee Meeting Schedule PDFs linked from 'url'); add next year's when the City posts it. For any year without a published schedule, 'usual' fills in (first and third Tuesday at 5:30 PM, per the city's Televised Meetings page). 'youtube' is the City's channel feed, used for meeting recordings and the weekly 'On the Town' events video. 'skip' (YYYY-MM-DD) drops a date the City cancels later; 'extra' adds a one-off meeting. .ics files in data/civic/ and URLs in 'feeds' are optional extra calendars.
